text: The Dispossessed has one copy. Which crate gets it?
Crate uses live Qloo evidence to connect each programme with books already in stock.
Then it packs both stalls without promising the same copy twice.
Now that copy sells out. Soul and City is already packed.
Keep it locked. Repair the other crate.
Kindred takes the open slot. The other seven placements stay.
Crate. Developed by Ajnas N B.
